phase: 0.9.1-rc.6 — First signed and notarized build. A Developer ID Application identity (Team NSCUV5G738) is installed; the app and DMG are code-signed with hardened runtime, notarized by Apple and stapled, so Gatekeeper opens them with no override step. Functionally identical to rc.5 (read-only scans, reviewed selections, explicit confirmations, protected-root validation, recoverable Trash actions; IntegrityCore is the current read-only integrity implementation; the retired ClamAV interface and scanner remain absent; public locale routes normalized to /en and /fr).
